evidence.notes: Local global describe is backed by loaded project object metadata.
Local describeSObjects accepts object names and SObjectType tokens for loaded project objects.
Local describe exposes object labels, field map, record type maps, and child relationship basics from metadata.
Seeded local BusinessHours records support deterministic weekday schedule addition.
Seeded local BusinessHours records support deterministic weekday schedule addition in GMT form.
Seeded local BusinessHours records support deterministic weekday schedule interval math.
Seeded local BusinessHours records support deterministic inside/outside checks.
Seeded local BusinessHours records support deterministic next weekday start lookup.

args: Map<String,Object> describes = Schema.getGlobalDescribe(); System.assert(describes.containsKey('Account')); System.assert(describes.containsKey('Contact')); Object accountType = describes.get('Account'); Object accountDescribe = accountType.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Account', accountDescribe.getName()); System.assertEquals('Accounts', accountDescribe.getLabelPlural()); System.assertEquals('001', accountDescribe.getKeyPrefix()); Map<String,Object> fields = accountDescribe.getFields().getMap(); System.assert(fields.containsKey('Name')); System.assert(fields.containsKey('Amount__c')); Object amountDescribe = fields.get('Amount__c').getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Amount', amountDescribe.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(12, amountDescribe.getPrecision()); System.assertEquals(2, amountDescribe.getScale()); List<Object> byName = Schema.describeSObjects(new List<String>{'Account'}); System.assertEquals('Account', byName.get(0).getName()); List<Object> byToken = Schema.describeSObjects(new List<Object>{accountType}); System.assertEquals('Account', byToken.get(0).getName()); Map<String,Object> recordTypes = accountDescribe.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName(); System.assert(recordTypes.containsKey('Business')); Object business = recordTypes.get('Business'); System.assertEquals('Business Account', business.getName()); System.assertEquals('Business', business.getDeveloperName()); System.assert(business.isActive()); System.assert(business.isAvailable()); System.assert(business.isDefaultRecordTypeMapping()); Object contacts = null; for (Object relationship : accountDescribe.getChildRelationships()) { if (relationship.getRelationshipName() == 'Contacts') { contacts = relationship; } } System.assert(contacts != null); System.assertEquals('Contacts', contacts.getRelationshipName()); System.assertEquals('AccountId', contacts.getField().getDescribe().getName()); System.assertEquals('Contact', contacts.getChildSObject().getDescribe().getName()); System.assert(contacts.isCascadeDelete()); Datetime mondayNine = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 6, 15, 16, 0, 0); Datetime fridayFour = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 6, 19, 23, 0, 0); Datetime nextMondayTen = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 6, 22, 17, 0, 0); System.assertEquals(true, BusinessHours.isWithin('01m000000000001AAA', mondayNine)); System.assertEquals(false, BusinessHours.isWithin('01m000000000001AAA', Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 6, 20, 16, 0, 0))); System.assertEquals(Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 6, 15, 17, 0, 0), BusinessHours.add('01m000000000001AAA', mondayNine, 60 * 60 * 1000)); System.assertEquals(nextMondayTen, BusinessHours.addGmt('01m000000000001AAA', fridayFour, 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000)); System.assertEquals(2 * 60 * 60 * 1000, BusinessHours.diff('01m000000000001AAA', fridayFour, nextMondayTen)); System.assertEquals(Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 6, 22, 16, 0, 0), BusinessHours.nextStartDate('01m000000000001AAA', Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 6, 20, 16, 0, 0)));
